title: Jukun Takum language
description: Jukunoid language of Cameroon and Nigeria
extract: Jukun (Njikun) or more precisely Jukun Takum, is a Jukunoid language of Cameroon used as a trade language in Nigeria. Though there are only a few thousand native speakers and only a dozen in Nigeria, it is spoken as a second language in Nigeria by tens of thousands.
